name: FFS_USER_LOG
description: Stores a modification history for the corresponding parent table.

columns.name: LOG_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the user log record.

columns.name: LOG_USER_ID
columns.description: User's log record user identifier who made chnages to user. Reference to ffs_user.uid.

columns.name: ACTION_ID
columns.description: User's log record action identifier. Reference to action log.

columns.name: USER_ID
columns.description: User's log record updated user ID . Reference to ffs_user.uid.

columns.name: REALM
columns.description: User's log record realm in Oracle Field Service.

columns.name: UNAME
columns.description: User's log record updated user name.

columns.name: ULOGIN
columns.description: User's log record updated user login.

columns.name: SUSTATUS
columns.description: User's log record updated user staus.

columns.name: LANGUAGE_ID
columns.description: User's log record updated user language. Reference to language.language_id.

columns.name: REFRESH_RATE
columns.description: User's log record updated user refresh rate.

columns.name: TIME_FORMAT_ID
columns.description: User's log record updated user time format.

columns.name: DATE_FORMAT_ID
columns.description: User's log record updated user date format.

columns.name: LONG_DATE_FORMAT_ID
columns.description: User's log record updated user long date format.

columns.name: TIME_ZONE_ID
columns.description: User's log record updated user time zone. Reference to ffs_time_zones.time_zone_id.

columns.name: USER_TYPE_ID
columns.description: User's log record updated user user type . Reference to ffs_catalog_user_type.type_id.

columns.name: LOGIN_ATTEMPTS
columns.description: User's log record updated user amount of failed login attempts.

columns.name: LOGIN_BLOCKED_TO
columns.description: User's log record updated user 'Block' flag after failed login attempts.

columns.name: LAST_LOGIN
columns.description: User's log record updated user last login timestamp.

columns.name: LAST_PASSWORD_CHANGE
columns.description: User's log record updated user last password update timestamp.

columns.name: MOBILE_RESOURCE_COUNT
columns.description: User's log record updated user count of Resources on the Mobility Application screens (the rest will be under More button).

columns.name: MOBILE_ACTIVITY_COUNT
columns.description: User's log record updated user count of Activities on the Mobility Application screens (the rest will be under More button).

columns.name: MOBILE_INVENTORY_COUNT
columns.description: User's log record updated user count of Inventories on the Mobility Application screens (the rest will be under More button).

columns.name: SUACTIONS_LINKS_NUM
columns.description: User's log record updated user count of Action Links on the Mobility Application screens (the rest will be under More button).

columns.name: SUWEEK_START
columns.description: User's log record updated user work week start ('Monday','Sunday').

columns.name: SUOPTIONS
columns.description: User's log record updated user options .

columns.name: SUCREATED
columns.description: User's log record updated user creation timestamp.

columns.name: SUUPDATED
columns.description: User's log record updated user last update timestamp.

columns.name: SOCIALNET_NEW_MESSAGE
columns.description: Deprecated. Will be removed soon.

columns.name: DEFAULT_EXPORT_FORMAT
columns.description: User's log record updated user default export file format.

columns.name: MAIN_RESOURCE_ID
columns.description: User's log record updated user 'main' resource for this user/technician. User can have access to several resources. Contains a reference to ffs_resource.resource_id. Used by Collaboration to identify message's recipient/sender.

columns.name: DESIGN_THEME
columns.description: User's log record updated user design theme.

columns.name: ALLOW_VIBRATION
columns.description: User's log record updated user flag to allow vibration in Mobility Application.

columns.name: ALLOW_DESKTOP_NOTIFICATIONS
columns.description: User's log record updated user flag to allow desktop notifications in Mobility Application.

columns.name: SOUND_THEME
columns.description: User's log record updated user Mobility Application selected sound theme.

columns.name: AVATAR
columns.description: User's log record updated user image(avatar).

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
